verdict.text: Access to create multi-user OAuth 2.0 applications requires applying for the Garmin Connect Developer Program (Starter Access application form). Once approved, developers can register apps with up to 1,000 users.
verdict.label: Sourced
verdict.quote: Apply for the Garmin Connect Developer Program and create an app with Starter Access.

difficulty_reason.text: Starter Access limits user capacity to up to 1,000 connected users.
difficulty_reason.label: Sourced
difficulty_reason.note: triggered the Medium rating: limits_before_approval[0] matched 'user cap'

hands_on_time.label: Inferred
hands_on_time.note: Submitting the Starter Access request form and configuring application details, callback URLs, and API access takes roughly 15-30 minutes.

waiting_time.label: Uncertain
waiting_time.note: Garmin documentation does not state the turnaround time for Starter Access form approval or Enterprise review.

composio_status.text: No Composio toolkit page found for this app.
composio_status.label: Inferred
composio_status.note: tried https://composio.dev/toolkits/garmin-connect, https://composio.dev/toolkits/garminconnect, https://composio.dev/toolkits/garmin; a toolkit may exist under a different slug

prerequisites.text: A Garmin Connect user account to access developer portals and manage developer programs.
prerequisites.label: Inferred
prerequisites.note: Accessing the developer portal and authorization pages requires a Garmin Connect login.

prerequisites.text: Application submitted for the Garmin Connect Developer Program Starter Access.
prerequisites.label: Sourced
prerequisites.quote: Apply for the Garmin Connect Developer Program and create an app with Starter Access.

setup_steps.text: Submit the Starter Access application form at https://www.garmin.com/en-US/forms/StarterGarminConnectDeveloperAccess/.
setup_steps.label: Inferred
setup_steps.note: Page 5 links to the Starter Access form under Business 'REQUEST NOW'.

setup_steps.text: Log in to the Garmin Developer Portal at https://developerportal.garmin.com/developer-programs/myapp and create a new application (or convert an existing app).
setup_steps.label: Inferred
setup_steps.note: Derived from developer portal app creation link and Nango integration instructions.

setup_steps.text: Configure the redirect callback URI for your application.
setup_steps.label: Inferred
setup_steps.note: Referenced in Nango docs and OAuth 2.0 specification parameters.

setup_steps.text: Select and configure the API sections your application requires (e.g., Activity, Health, Training, Courses, Women's Health).
setup_steps.label: Inferred
setup_steps.note: Supported by OAuth spec stating API sections are managed during app creation.

setup_steps.text: Copy the generated OAuth2 Client ID and Client Secret.
setup_steps.label: Inferred
setup_steps.note: Mentioned in Nango instructions and standard OAuth 2.0 PKCE spec.

setup_steps.text: Configure data delivery settings and webhooks via Garmin API Tools at https://healthapi.garmin.com/tools/login.
setup_steps.label: Sourced
setup_steps.quote: Configure your data delivery settings using API Tools

setup_steps.text: Implement OAuth 2.0 with PKCE (S256 code challenge method) using the authorization endpoint https://connect.garmin.com/oauth2Confirm and token endpoint https://diauth.garmin.com/di-oauth2-service/oauth/token.
setup_steps.label: Sourced
setup_steps.quote: Garmin Connect Developer Program uses the OAuth2.0 PKCE version.

scopes.text: API scopes cannot be requested or customized in authorization or token URL parameters; scope is returned by default by the API based on application configuration (e.g., 'PARTNER_WRITE PARTNER_READ CONNECT_READ CONNECT_WRITE').
scopes.label: Sourced
scopes.quote: Scope is a default API scope and cannot be modified. API sections are managed during the app creation process.

scopes.text: Granular user permissions (such as ACTIVITY_EXPORT, WORKOUT_IMPORT, HEALTH_EXPORT, COURSE_IMPORT, MCT_EXPORT) are chosen directly by the user on the Garmin consent screen.
scopes.label: Sourced
scopes.quote: Users control permissions granted during the authorization step.

limits_before_approval.text: Starter Access limits user capacity to up to 1,000 connected users.
limits_before_approval.label: Sourced

limits_before_approval.text: Starter Access delivers data via Push only (no Ping/Pull).
limits_before_approval.label: Sourced

limits_before_approval.text: Historical data is not included under Starter Access.
limits_before_approval.label: Sourced

limits_before_approval.text: Access tokens expire after 24 hours (86,400 seconds) while refresh tokens are valid for approximately 90 days (7,775,998 seconds).
limits_before_approval.label: Inferred
limits_before_approval.note: Derived from token response examples in the OAuth2 PKCE specification.

approval_process.text: Organizations must apply for the Garmin Connect Developer Program to receive Starter Access credentials.
approval_process.label: Sourced
approval_process.quote: Apply for the Garmin Connect Developer Program and create an app with Starter Access.

approval_process.text: To scale beyond 1,000 users, receive historical data (1 month+), or use Ping/Pull delivery, an organization must request Enterprise Access with Garmin.
approval_process.label: Sourced
approval_process.quote: Available options and commercial terms are tailored based on business and technical requirements.

likely_blockers.text: Commercial terms or tailored business evaluation required for Enterprise Access if needing more than 1,000 users.
likely_blockers.label: Sourced
likely_blockers.quote: Available options and commercial terms are tailored based on business and technical requirements.

likely_blockers.text: Attempting to build multi-user apps using the Personal API instead of the Developer Program (Personal API keys are strictly single-user).
likely_blockers.label: Sourced
likely_blockers.quote: It is not intended for commercial applications serving multiple end users.

likely_blockers.text: Failing to implement required PKCE parameters (code_verifier and code_challenge with S256) on authorization and token exchanges.
likely_blockers.label: Sourced
likely_blockers.quote: Garmin Connect Developer Program uses the OAuth2.0 PKCE version.

likely_blockers.text: Failing to implement the mandatory user deregistration endpoint (DELETE /wellness-api/rest/user/registration) when users disconnect or delete their accounts.
likely_blockers.label: Sourced
likely_blockers.quote: This endpoint must be called if the partner website or application provides a “Delete My Account” or “Disconnect” mechanism

agent_can_do: Generate code verifier and code challenge using S256 for PKCE implementation
Format OAuth2 authorization and token refresh HTTP requests
Draft the integration code for user permission checks and account deregistration webhooks
you_must_do: Fill out and submit the Garmin Connect Developer Program Starter Access request form
Log into the Garmin Developer Portal to configure callback URLs and API access
Securely copy and store the OAuth2 Client ID and Client Secret

open_questions.text: What are the specific review criteria and average response time for Starter Access form submissions?
open_questions.label: Uncertain
open_questions.note: Documentation provides the form link but does not document evaluation criteria or review turnaround times.

open_questions.text: What are the commercial pricing tiers and legal contract requirements for Enterprise Access?
open_questions.label: Uncertain
open_questions.note: Documentation states options and terms are tailored based on requirements, but details are not published.
